    (desc); each model goes to the GPU whose remaining budget
    (T*free_g - load_g) best fits the model's rate (minimum leftover >= 0),

    provides the upper bound / fallback. ~40 bisection iterations, keeping
    the best feasible placement found. Always returns gpu_id -> list.

        free = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
        load = [0.0] * gpu_num

            r = model.req_rate / model.slo
